Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the NEXUS S1 at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.
Looked up for Sarah: First miner — the S1 is $699, 10 TH/s, 150 W, about $11 a month at 10¢, quiet at 50 dB, WiFi setup, power supply and stand in the box.
Nice, a first miner. At ten cents the S1 costs about eleven dollars a month in power. Is this mostly for learning Bitcoin?
Looked up for Sarah: S1 runs ~50 dB, about a quiet fan — fine on a desk. Heads up: it's batch two, in transit to the warehouse, ships as soon as it lands.
Good spot for it. The S1 runs at about fifty decibels, like a quiet fan, sets up over WiFi, and comes with its power supply and stand. Want to grab one?
Looked up for Sarah: Ask which plug, US, EU or UK, then I'll send the link. Same $699 also comes as Nexus S1 plus a free Lucky LV08 bundle.
Great choice. The N. S1 is six ninety-nine, and it ships as soon as batch two lands at the warehouse. The A. to cart button is right there on the page. Found it?
Looked up for Sarah: At checkout they pick the plug — US, EU or UK — and it must match the shipping address; a wrong-region plug can't ship. Cards, PayPal, Afterpay or Solana Pay all work.
Perfect. Heads up: for the same six ninety-nine there's also an S1 bundle that includes a free Lucky LV08. Want to switch to that one? (The call ended. 4 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
